logout.question: Are you sure you want to log out?

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Sign in with your company account to see your personalised matches.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.subtitle: Enter the email address of your account and we'll send a 6-digit code to set a new password.
forgot.sent: If an account belongs to this email address, we've sent the code. It's valid for 10 minutes.
forgot.doneBody: For your security we signed you out on every device. Sign in with your new password.

register.title: Create a company account
register.subtitle: Three details are enough: email, password and tax number. We read the company name and seat from the NAV register; you only confirm them.

fields.taxNumberHelp: E.g. 12345678 or 12345678-1-42. We check the number, then show you the company it belongs to.

actions.confirmCompany: This is my company — create account

adminHint: Demo access: admin / admin — administrator account for granting subscriptions.

confirm.title: NAV lists this company
confirm.name: Company name
confirm.notActive: NAV lists this taxpayer as "{{status}}", so an account cannot be created for it.

consent.terms: I accept the Terms of Service and have read the Privacy Notice.
consent.marketing: Send me newsletters and news of new funding opportunities (withdraw any time).

validation.terms: To register you need to accept the terms and the privacy notice.
validation.taxNumber: Enter a valid Hungarian tax number (8 or 11 digits, with a correct check digit).
validation.password: The password must be at least 12 characters.
